title: Storyworks Screens
heading: Storyworks screens
intro: Rendered from the dev build in a 1280×800 window. Click an image to open it full size. Newest milestone first.

sections.title: Checked
items: Codex list, entry editor and types: driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark (starter types; create, rename, change type, aliases, tags, notes, appendix, search by alias, type and tag filters, types dialog, delete with reassign, last type blocked, Trash and restore, keyboard in the list).

Links, Light and Dark: alias "Aldric", Polish alias "Żmija" and non-matches ("Aldrich", "Żmijami") on the Mentions tab; Link in one click gives a plum marker and an Appears in card; Not this one hides it and it stays hidden after reopening; Link all; Link to… picker with remembered tab, keyboard tab switching and alias search; event plus codex link shows both shapes; popover Open and Unlink.

Deleting an entry: broken triangles, popover Missing entry, Problems, This paragraph, POV Missing entry with Clear, node chip Missing entry; Trash restore repairs all. Event chips, rules Used by entries, timeline filter, In this scene, Linked and Links panels. Event links from M4 behave as before (Events tab, Jump, delete and restore an event).

Fixed on the way: the Add a rule box kept the picked title; the sidebar showed "Coming soon"; the entry delete confirm did not count linked passages; the mixed marker label read "1 events and 1 codex entries".

Mention scan on a 500-scene, 300k-word book with 200 entries: about 50 ms plus the 300 ms debounce, so no cache was added. The browser build reads from memory; the real window reads 500 files, so the Tauri check should time it.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (entry and type files, image copy, ignored-findings file, manifest v6).

sections.title: Checked
items: Driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark: default categories, create, retitle, change category, tags, description and exceptions saved; search, category and tag filters, no match, Clear filters.

Category dialog: recolour, rename, add, delete with reassign, last category blocked (message shown as text). Rules section in the inspector via the picker with keyboard only, Open chip to the rule and Used in back to the event, Linked card.

Delete a rule: confirm shows the event count, chip turns Missing rule with a Problem card, Trash restore repairs it. Keyboard in the list: Tab, Enter, Space; Escape closes dialogs. Manifest v5 with rule and trash entries. No console errors.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (rule and category files, manifest v5, trash folder).

sections.title: Checked
items: Driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark: link one paragraph, link two selected paragraphs, badge popover, Jump to the event, Written in lists the passage, Jump back.

Delete the event: confirm shows the count, marker turns broken, Problems lists it; restore from Trash repairs it; relink a broken link; cut and paste a linked paragraph into another scene and the link follows.
Keyboard: Enter on a marker opens the popover, Escape closes it. 27 checks per theme pass, no console errors.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (link, close, reopen, inspect files).

sections.title: Checked
items: A branch and merge is built in the UI, saved and found again after closing and reopening the project.
A connection that would make a loop is refused with a message; no connection is added.
After the calendar changes, dates that no longer fit are flagged and keep their value.
